name: directsurface
description: Canvas GUI framework for desktop-grade browser workspaces

scripts.prepack: npm run check:icons && npm run check:docs && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:package
scripts.verify:consumer: node scripts/setup_example.mjs && npm run test:consumer:charts && npm run test:example:state && npm --prefix examples/basic-app run typecheck && npm --prefix examples/basic-app run build
scripts.example:dev: node scripts/setup_example.mjs && npm --prefix examples/basic-app run dev
scripts.test:framework:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.framework.config.mjs
scripts.procurement:check: npm --prefix examples/procurement-workbench run check && npm --prefix examples/procurement-workbench test
scripts.build:site: npm --prefix examples/basic-app run build && npm run procurement:build && node scripts/assemble_site.mjs
